summary: Compared the retained 1920 px reference, rendered crop and diff for contact-form against the frozen section source. The outer geometry passes within one pixel (expected 728,519,953,376; actual 728,520,952,376) and the crop ratio is 5.204%, but visible required source content is missing or displaced.

CONTACT-FORM-002 | medium | typography/position | Expected the heading with clear top inset at the upper right; actual heading touches and is clipped by the crop top, and its horizontal position differs. Fix: restore the source heading inset/alignment while preserving the passing outer bounds.

CONTACT-FORM-003 | medium | field typography | Expected small light-gray labels with source insets; actual labels are visibly larger and lower-contrast placement differs across the inputs and textarea. Fix: match the captured 12 px label metric and source padding.
